body.name: Gamma
body.def: \(\Gamma_{ab}(\beta)=\frac{1-\eta}{2\alpha}f_{\beta}(q_{\alpha,\beta})\mathcal C_{ab}(\beta,q_{\alpha,\beta})\) for \(a,b\le r\), the Gaussian acceptance-boundary Hessian induced by the common experiment-indexed oracle limit and the continuous coarea conditional-covariance version.
